correctness.rationale: For six distinct labels exactly 56 nontrivial subsets are optional, each selected subfamily uniquely determines a clustering system. The witness test C\(\bigcup_{D\text{ overlapping }C}D) is equivalent to NOC, is hereditary under deletions and can only lose witnesses as sets are added, so pruning is exhaustive. Each accepted family is stratified by the number of strict Hasse parents (>=2). Two separately coded C++ source implementations independently enumerated all accepted n=6 families: 9,654,368, by k=0..4 the vector (2752,79076,1037235,4511390,4023915). Direct Python brute all n<=4 agrees. Corollary 11 in Lindeberg–Hellmuth full paper establishes exactly the canonical network interpretation; that prior correspondence is not credited as newly proved.
